name: Camille Fontaine
headline: Senior Product Manager | Product Strategy & Growth
summary: Senior Product Manager with 9 years of experience driving product strategy, growth, and data-informed decision-making across SaaS and marketplace platforms. Skilled at leading cross-functional teams through discovery, experimentation, and scaled delivery, with a strong track record of using SQL and A/B testing to inform roadmap decisions and improve user outcomes.

responsibilities: Define and own product strategy for the core subscription platform serving over 500,000 users
Lead quarterly roadmap planning in collaboration with engineering, design, and marketing teams
Design and analyze A/B tests to optimize onboarding flows and reduce churn
Write SQL queries to extract and analyze product usage data for decision-making
Mentor two junior product managers and facilitate sprint planning sessions
Managed the product lifecycle for a B2B marketplace feature set from ideation to launch
Conducted user interviews and synthesized findings into actionable product requirements
Collaborated with data analysts to design experiments and interpret A/B test results
Partnered with engineering leads to prioritize backlog based on business impact
Presented product performance metrics to executive stakeholders quarterly
Supported senior PMs in gathering requirements and writing user stories
Analyzed customer feedback and usage data to identify improvement opportunities
Assisted in coordinating cross-functional launches for new feature releases
Tracked KPIs and prepared reporting dashboards for leadership review
